# AppForge

> A high-performance, zero-dependency Flutter micro-framework providing core infrastructure: Reactive State Management, Route-Bound Dependency Injection, Context-Free Navigation & Overlays, Bidirectional (BiDi) Arabic Localization, Theming, and Responsive Scaling.

## Canonical Reference
- Full AI & Agent Guide: [AI.md](AI.md)
- Technical Specification: [SPECIFICATION.md](SPECIFICATION.md)
- Development Guidelines: [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)
- Changelog: [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)

## Core Capabilities & Quick Reference

### 1. Zero External Dependencies
- Uses strictly the Dart Standard Library and Flutter SDK.
- Never add or recommend third-party packages for state, routing, localization, or screen sizing.

### 2. Reactive State & Dependency Injection
- `final count = 0.obs;` -> `count.value++`
- `Watch((context) => Text('${count.value}'))` (surgical leaf rebuilds)
- `Watch.listen(target: count, listener: (context, val) => ...)` (side-effects without child rebuild)
- `count.listen((val) => ...)` / `count.listenPrev((prev, next) => ...)`
- `items.update((list) => list.add(x))` (in-place mutation + notify)
- Rx equality is identity-based: compare `a.value == b.value`, never `a == b`
- `UiState<T>` (idle, loading, success, failure) -> `Watch.state(...)`
- `App.put<T>(T instance)` / `App.lazyPut<T>(() => instance)`
- `final service = App.find<T>();`
- `AppBind<T>(init: () => T(), autoDispose: true, builder: (context, controller) => ...)` (supports nested route instance stacking)

### 3. Context-Free Navigation & Overlays
- `App.to(Screen(), arguments: args)` / `App.arguments` (tracks native route stack; preserves page args during dialogs)
- `App.off(Screen())`
- `App.offAll(Screen())`
- `App.back([result])`
- `App.navigatorObserver` (wired automatically by `MasterApp`)
- `App.snackbar('Title', 'Message', type: SnackType.success)`
- `App.dialog(Widget child)`
- `App.showLoading()` / `App.hideLoading()` (isolated DialogRoute dismissal; never pops error dialogs)

### 4. Arabic & BiDi Localization Engine
- `'key'.tr` (automatically isolates mixed Arabic + Latin tokens, hashtags like `#AppForge`, handles `@user`, and phone numbers `+974...` in RTL)
- `'welcome'.trParams({'name': 'Ali'})`
- `'cases'.trPlural(count)` (supports all 6 Arabic plural forms)
- `'user_status'.trGender()` (morphology agreeing with user gender)
- `phone.asPhone` / `tag.asTag` (optional manual isolates for raw untranslated strings outside `.tr`)
- `text.isolateMixed` (automatic/explicit UAX #9 isolation for mixed Latin inside RTL)
- `text.stripTashkeel` (removes all 9 Harakat marks)
- `text.stripTatweel` (removes Kashida `ـ`)
- `text.fuzzyContainsArabic(query)` (diacritic-insensitive search)
- `text.formatArabic()` (all-in-one proofreading, punctuation normalization & autocorrect)
- `text.fixArabicPunctuation()`, `text.fixArabicWaw()`, `text.autocorrectArabic()`
- `text.toArabicKeyboard()` (QWERTY to Arabic mistyping converter)
- `ArabicTextInputFormatter()` (real-time Word/Gboard style TextField formatter)
- `sentence.inflectArabicGender(AppGender.female)` (inflects 2nd person pronouns and `كَ` vs `كِ`)
- `'حمزة'.arabicGender` -> `AppGender.male` (11-category grammatical classifier)
- Universal built-in dictionary: `'save'.tr` / `'common_save'.tr`, `'close'.tr` / `'common_close'.tr`, `'ok'.tr` / `'common_ok'.tr`, `'loading'.tr`, `'retry'.tr`, `'settings'.tr`
- Static translation LRU memoization & snapshotting: O(1) nanosecond lookups with zero string allocations or regex passes on re-renders
- Literal token auto-bypass: UI literals passed to `.tr` (`+974 5500 1234.tr`, `#flutter.tr`, `https://...tr`) are automatically isolated for BiDi without polluting missing keys or auditor reports

### 5. Theming & Responsiveness
- `App.setThemeMode(ThemeMode.dark)`
- `context.isDark`
- `MasterApp(harmonizeTheme: true)` (auto-harmonizes dark/light theme when only one is supplied; zero mutation when both are provided)
- `AppThemeHarmonizer.contrastRatio(c1, c2)` (W3C WCAG 2.1 relative contrast ratio)
- `context.contrastColor(bg)` (returns high-contrast text color against dynamic background)
- `color.ensureContrast(against: bg)` (shifts luminance to enforce >= 4.5:1 ratio)
- `120.w`, `60.h`, `16.sp`, `12.r`, `16.gapY`, `8.gapX` (.sp scales by design geometry without double-scaling accessibility font scale)
- `context.w(120)`, `context.h(60)`, `context.sp(16)`, `context.r(12)` (inherited MediaQuery dependency for rotation/split-screen)
- `App.responsiveMetricsNotifier` (tracks screen size/orientation transitions)
- `MasterApp(themeMode: ...)` sets initial mode; dynamic toggling via `App.toggleTheme()` always works; derived themes are memoized

### 6. Project Cleaner & Resource Auditor
- `App.auditTranslations()` (checks cross-locale gaps, empty keys, runtime missing keys, and dead keys)
- `AppLocalization.instance.missingKeys` / `onMissingKey` (tracks missing requested keys at runtime)
- `AppAssetAuditor.findUnusedAssets(dir)` (unreferenced images/icons in `assets/`)
- `AppFileAuditor.findOrphanFiles(dir)` (unimported `.dart` files in `lib/`)
- `AppCleanReverter.revert(dir)` (restores pruned translations, assets, and files to exact paths)
- CLI: `dart run appforge:clean` (audit all), `dart run appforge:clean --fix` (prune dead items with backup), `dart run appforge:clean --revert` (1-command rollback)

### 7. Network Connectivity Monitor
- `App.isOnline` (reactive `Rx<bool>` tracking real internet reachability)
- `App.isOffline` (convenient boolean check)
- `App.onConnectivityChanged` (broadcast stream of connectivity transitions)
- `App.checkConnectivity()` (parallel candidate host racing to 1.1.1.1 / 8.8.8.8, completing on fastest responder)
- In-flight check deduplication: concurrent callers share a single active lookup.
- Lifecycle-aware monitoring: backgrounding (`paused`, `hidden`, `detached`) automatically pauses polling; returning (`resumed`) resumes immediately with an active check.
- `App.startConnectivityMonitor()` / `App.stopConnectivityMonitor()`

### 8. Atomic Key-Value Storage (AppStorage)
- `await App.initStorage()` (initializes RAM cache from disk at startup)
- `App.storageRead<T>('key', defaultValue: val)` (0ms synchronous read from RAM)
- `App.storageRead<List<String>>('tags')` (typed collection read with runtime casting)
- `App.storageWrite('key', val)` (instant synchronous write + off-main-thread serialized atomic POSIX swap)
- `App.storageRemove('key')` / `App.storageClear()` / `App.storageHas('key')`
- `App.storageBox('auth')` (named isolated container partition)
- `App.storage.listenKey<T>('key', (val) => ...)` (reactive key change listener)
- JSON types only (throws `ArgumentError` on unsupported types to protect disk state)
- Copy-on-read isolation (mutating returned lists/maps never silently diverges from disk)
- Automatic background flush on app pause/exit via `AppLifecycleManager`
- iOS `Library/Application Support` storage with legacy migration
- `MasterApp(persistLocale: true, persistTheme: true)` (zero-boilerplate auto persistence)

### 9. Environment Configuration (AppEnv)
- `await App.loadEnv()` / `AppEnv.load()` (loads .env with `${VAR}` interpolation)
- RFC & POSIX compliant: CRLF normalization, single-quote literals (`'...'`) bypass interpolation and escape sequences.
- Undefined variables (`$100`, `$UNKNOWN`) preserved literally without truncation.
- `App.env('KEY', defaultValue: '')` / `App.envInt()`, `App.envDouble()`, `App.envBool()`
- `App.hasEnv('KEY')` / `App.envMaskedMap` (automatic secret masking)

### 10. Skeleton Shimmer Engine (AppShimmer)
- `myWidget.shimmer(enabled: isLoading)` (automatic layout-adaptive shimmer sweep)
- 60-120Hz zero-jank path caching: Render tree skeleton bones paths are cached on layout and animated via translated canvas without per-frame tree walks or text measurement.
- `AppShimmer.box()`, `AppShimmer.circle()`, `AppShimmer.text()`, `AppShimmer.listTile()`, `AppShimmer.card()`
- BiDi reading-direction sweep (sweeps RTL in Arabic, LTR in English automatically)

### 11. In-Memory Cache Engine (AppCache)
- `AppCache.get<T>('key')` / `AppCache.set('key', value, ttl: Duration(minutes: 5))`
- Monotonic microsecond clock (`Stopwatch`): TTL expiration is 100% immune to system clock tampering, timezone shifts, and NTP jumps.
- `AppCache.getOrFetch<T>('key', () => fetcher())` (atomic cache-aside with single-flight request coalescing and clean hit metrics)
- Generation guard: In-flight fetches started before `clear()` never resurrect stale data into an emptied cache.
- `AppCache.bucket('name', maxEntries: 50, evictionPolicy: CacheEvictionPolicy.lru)` (.lru, .lfu, .fifo)
- `AppCache.invalidate('key')` / `AppCache.invalidateWhere(predicate)` / `AppCache.pruneExpired()`
- `AppCache.stats` (hits, misses, hitRate, evictions, expirations)
- `App.cache` / `App.cacheBucket('name')` (root facade accessors)
